oip_v2_2e_2b2k_funnel.methodology: Shared Acquisition is evidenced by cohort-mint EXTRACTION_STARTED lifecycle telemetry. Completion is the intersection of those started mints with COMPLETED queue lifecycle/state. Retained requires at least one RETAINED acquisition observation for the mint. Replayable requires a retained observation with every canonical dry-run envelope input present.
oip_v2_2e_2b2k_funnel.gap_analysis: Five of 20 migrations did not enter Shared Acquisition. Four had canonical migrated token rows and resolved creator data but no creator_funding_queue row. One additional migration had a complete queue row satisfied by existing creator-funder state and therefore bypassed Shared Acquisition; it is not counted as a downstream completion in the linear acquisition funnel. All 15 actual Shared Acquisition mints completed, retained, and were replayable.

oip_v2_2e_2b2l_root_cause.scope: The five qualified migration mints that did not invoke Shared Acquisition in the B2K linear funnel.
oip_v2_2e_2b2l_root_cause.evidence: For four mints, listener logs record successful creator resolution followed by FUNDING_QUEUE cache-hit returns; local database state proves each creator had a prior completed creator_funding_queue row, so _enqueue_creator_funding_job returned before inserting a current-mint row. The fifth mint was enqueued, then creator_funding_worker reconciliation marked it complete because creator_funders already existed, without EXTRACTION_STARTED. All 15 mints that actually entered Shared Acquisition completed, retained, and replayed successfully.
three_cache_boundaries: pumpfun_curve_listener._enqueue_creator_funding_job returns cache_hit before per-mint queue persistence when creator_funders is fresh or any prior creator queue row is complete
creator_funding_worker._recover_stale_rows marks pending/retry rows complete when any creator_funders row exists, before _process_job
realtime_creator_funding_extractor.extract_funding_for_new_token returns known_creator_fast when any creator_funders row exists, before acquisition_scope and SharedTransactionAcquisition
oip_v2_2e_2b2l_root_cause.semantic_assessment: The business workflow treats creator-level cached funding as complete, while the OIP funnel requires a current-mint Shared Acquisition invocation and retained replayable envelope. The 25% gap is therefore a real evidence-coverage gap caused by intended production cache semantics, not a listener migration-routing defect.
oip_v2_2e_2b2l_root_cause.smallest_coherent_repair_not_implemented: Introduce an explicit per-queue observation_required/force_fresh_acquisition marker for the reviewed migration evidence cohort, set it on migration enqueue, and honor it across all three cache boundaries so the job reaches acquisition_scope and SharedTransactionAcquisition. This deliberately creates provider work and requires separate RPC-budget, schema, local-qualification, and production-activation authorization. Merely inserting cache-hit queue rows or relabeling cache satisfaction would not create a current-mint retained replayable envelope.
oip_v2_2e_2b2l_root_cause.provider_free_alternative_rejected: Linking a prior mint's retained response to the current mint would require a new cache-lineage evidence contract; rewriting retained metadata would fabricate launch provenance and is not acceptable.
